scope: Independent adversarial data audit (DA9) of three current-holding dossiers not previously checked by this auditor: MA, AXP, MSCI. 21 load-bearing facts checked (7/7/7 by ticker), selected for the claims most likely to break a thesis or a kill criterion if wrong: headline quarterly figures, guidance track records, capital/credit ratios, deal terms/dates, litigation status, and capital-return figures. Method: primary sources only -- SEC EDGAR 10-Q/10-K text and notes, 8-K Ex-99.1/Ex-99.2 earnings-release exhibits, and data.sec.gov XBRL companyconcept pulls -- fetched directly from www.sec.gov and data.sec.gov (User-Agent 'PersonalEquityResearch research-admin@personal-research.org') and cited by accession/URL below. Each dossier was read to its end; no appended 'Correction' sections were found on any of the three. Each ticker's one-line thesis and first kill criterion were checked for consistency with the underlying filings; results noted in the summary below.

facts.claim: Debt (consolidated, 30-Jun-2026): $6.0bn Senior Notes + $475m Revolving Credit Facility = ~$6.475bn total debt; cash $352.7m; net debt ≈$6.12bn
facts.source: MSCI Form 10-Q, period 2026-06-30, filed 2026-07-21 (accession 0001408198-26-000046), Note 7 "Debt" and Condensed Balance Sheet
facts.source_value: "As of June 30, 2026, we had an aggregate of $6.0 billion in Senior Notes outstanding. In addition,...we had as of June 30, 2026 an aggregate of $475.0 million in outstanding borrowings under the Revolving Credit Facility." Balance sheet: "Cash and cash equivalents (includes restricted cash of $3.7... at June 30, 2026...) $356.4" million
facts.note: Total debt ($6.0bn + $475m = $6.475bn) matches exactly. The dossier's cash figure ($352.7m) is the balance-sheet cash line net of the $3.7m restricted-cash component ($356.4M - $3.7M = $352.7M) rather than the reported gross line ($356.4M) -- a reasonable, correctly-computed sub-figure, not an error. Net debt on either basis rounds to ~$6.12bn, matching the dossier.

facts.claim: Company-wide Retention Rate 95.3% in Q2 2026, vs 93.4% "a year ago in Q4 2025"
facts.source: MSCI 8-K Ex-99.1, Q2 2026 earnings release; MSCI 8-K Ex-99.1, Q4/FY2025 earnings release
facts.source_value: Q2 2026 release: "Retention Rate in second quarter 2026 was 95.3%, compared to 94.4% in second quarter 2025." Q4 2025 release: "Retention Rate in fourth quarter 2025 was 93.4%, compared to 93.1% in fourth quarter 2024."
facts.note: Both numeric values (95.3% for Q2 2026, 93.4% for Q4 2025) are exactly correct per the primary sources. However, Q4 2025 is two quarters (six months) before Q2 2026, not "a year ago" as the kill-criterion text states -- the true year-ago comparator for Q2 2026 is Q2 2025's 94.4% Retention Rate (also confirmed above), which is actually closer to today's 95.3% than the cited 93.4% figure is. This is a labeling/temporal-reference error, not a fabricated number, and does not change the kill-criterion threshold (92%) or its current distance from breach either way.
